id: 08_Lesson 2 How to Cut and Weld a Practical Product？
title: 激光切割加焊接：做一个调料架
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/08_Lesson 2 How to Cut and Weld a Practical Product？.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/08_Lesson 2 How to Cut and Weld a Practical Product？/src.py

points.K7: 连线开机，确认安全须知

shots.scene: 欣欣站在工作台旁，台上放着一个装满调料瓶的不锈钢架子，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a bench with a stainless steel spice rack full of jars and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：切割加焊接，做一个调料架。
overlay: 激光切割加焊接：做一个调料架

shots.scene: 切割机、焊接头、调料架三个图标用箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: Three icons joined by arrows: an enclosed cutting machine, a handheld welding head and a finished rack. No people.
shots.narration: 先切零件，再焊成架子。

shots.scene: 小研拿着调料架的空白设计图，兴致勃勃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank drawing of a spice rack, looking excited.
shots.narration: 小研想给茶水间做个调料架。

shots.scene: 老李指指切割机和焊机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the enclosed cutting machine and the handheld welder.
shots.narration: 老李说：先切零件，再焊起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从备料开始，一步步做。

shots.scene: 调料架挂在墙上，螺丝穿过孔
shots.prompt_en: A stainless steel spice rack hangs on a wall with screws through its keyhole openings, holding a few jars. No people.
shots.narration: 架子靠孔挂墙，装拆都方便。

shots.scene: 一块不锈钢板，旁边厚度卡尺图标
shots.prompt_en: A stainless steel sheet with a thickness gauge icon beside its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 先定材料和厚度，这次是2毫米不锈钢。

shots.scene: 空白推荐表，四列图标：气体、喷嘴、气压、参数
shots.prompt_en: A blank recommendation table with column icons for gas, nozzle, pressure gauge and settings. No people.
shots.narration: 它决定气体、喷嘴、气压和参数。

shots.scene: 空压机、冷干机、焊机三台设备用气管连成一串
shots.prompt_en: An air compressor, an air dryer and a welder unit connected in a row by air hoses, with arrows showing flow. No people.
shots.narration: 空压机接冷干机，冷干机接焊机。

shots.scene: 冷干机进出口两个接头被标出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of an air dryer with its inlet and outlet ports highlighted by two arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 认准冷干机的进气口和出气口。

shots.scene: 先开冷干机再开空压机，空压机显示屏数值上升
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches on the air dryer, then the compressor; the compressor display shows a rising blank bar. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 先开冷干机，再开空压机。

shots.scene: 空压机显示屏特写，数值停在设定值
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the compressor display panel with a blank bar reaching its set mark. No people.
shots.narration: 气压设为1兆帕，等它产气。

shots.scene: 焊接头两槽对准滑架两销，装上去
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands align two grooves of the welding head with two pins on the cutting machine carriage and fit it in place.
shots.narration: 焊接头的槽对准销，装上滑架。

shots.scene: 刚用过的焊接头发热，手戴上耐热手套
shots.prompt_en: A welding head glowing slightly warm with a hot icon; a hand pulls on a leather heat-resistant glove.
shots.narration: 刚加工完，先戴耐热手套。

shots.scene: 一只手旋下普通喷嘴，旋上省气喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: A bare hand unscrews a copper nozzle from the cutting head and screws on a different copper nozzle.
shots.narration: 同样先戴耐热手套，换上省气喷嘴。

shots.scene: 撕掉不锈钢板两面的保护膜
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands peel a blue protective film off both sides of a stainless steel sheet.
shots.narration: 撕掉2毫米不锈钢两面的保护膜。

shots.scene: 板材两端插进左右夹具槽
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands slide the sheet into the right fixture slot and then the left slot inside the cutting machine.
shots.narration: 两端插进夹具槽，对齐。

shots.scene: 放下联动杆，拧紧两侧旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands lower a linkage lever and tighten the knobs on both fixtures.
shots.narration: 放下联动杆，拧紧旋钮。

shots.section_title: 连线开机，确认安全须知
shots.scene: 数据线连接切割机和电脑
shots.prompt_en: A data cable runs from the cutting machine to a laptop; the machine power switch is on. No people.
shots.narration: 连上电脑，切割机开机。
overlay: 连线开机，确认安全须知

shots.section_title: 连线开机，确认安全须知
shots.scene: 焊机屏幕上安全须知页，几条图标
shots.prompt_en: The welder touchscreen shows a safety notice page with icons for goggles, a ventilation fan, a fire symbol and a ground symbol, and a confirm bar. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机开机，读完安全须知再确认。

shots.section_title: 连线开机，确认安全须知
shots.scene: 焊机屏幕显示由切割机控制的图标
shots.prompt_en: The welder touchscreen shows an icon of the cutting machine with a link symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 等屏幕显示由切割机控制。

shots.scene: 笔记本电脑上新建项目，摄像头画面显示板材
shots.prompt_en: A laptop shows a new blank project and a live camera view of the metal sheet inside the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 新建项目，摄像头看材料好定位。

shots.scene: 导入调料架零件图
shots.prompt_en: On the laptop, blank outlines of rack parts appear on the camera view. No people.
shots.narration: 导入要切的零件图。

shots.scene: 引入线示意：从轮廓外一小段线接到轮廓上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a part outline with a short lead line starting outside the outline and joining it. No people.
shots.narration: 板厚2毫米及以上，要加引入线。

shots.scene: 起切点的小缺口留在轮廓外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram showing a small start mark left on the scrap side outside the outline, while the part edge stays smooth. No people.
shots.narration: 起切的缺陷留在外面，轮廓更完整。

shots.scene: 引入线长度与板厚对比的标尺
shots.prompt_en: Diagram comparing a lead line length with the plate thickness, marked one to three times. No people.
shots.narration: 长度为板厚1到3倍，约3到10毫米。

shots.scene: 一段引入线旁边的尺寸箭头
shots.prompt_en: A single lead line with a size arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这次外引入线设4毫米。

shots.scene: 实心轮廓变黑，镂空轮廓为红
shots.prompt_en: On the laptop, solid outer outlines turn black while hollow inner outlines stay red. No people.
shots.narration: 实心轮廓标黑，镂空轮廓标红。

shots.scene: 黑色轮廓外侧加引入线
shots.prompt_en: On the laptop, short lead lines appear outside each black outline. No people.
shots.narration: 黑色加外引入线。

shots.scene: 红色镂空内部加短一点的引入线
shots.prompt_en: On the laptop, slightly shorter lead lines appear inside each red hollow outline. No people.
shots.narration: 红色加内引入线，可短些如3毫米。

shots.scene: 引入线伸进零件的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a lead line cutting into the part that should be kept, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 内引入线要放在废料里，别伤零件。

shots.scene: 软件右栏四个选项：模式、材料、喷嘴、气体
shots.prompt_en: On the laptop, a side panel with four blank options marked by icons: a clamp, a metal sheet, a nozzle and an air compressor. No people.
shots.narration: 夹具切割、2毫米不锈钢、省气嘴、空压机。

shots.scene: 切割头下降到板面，进度条走动
shots.prompt_en: The cutting head lowers to the metal sheet while a progress bar fills on the laptop. No people.
shots.narration: 点实心处，校准电容传感器。

shots.scene: 红光沿边框走一圈，离板边留出距离
shots.prompt_en: A red aiming dot traces a dashed frame on the sheet, with a margin arrow to the sheet edge. No people.
shots.narration: 走边框看位置，离板边至少1.5厘米。

shots.scene: 电脑上空白检查页，旋钮图标
shots.prompt_en: On the laptop, a blank check-before-processing page with a knob icon and a check list. No people.
shots.narration: 点加工，按提示调切割头旋钮。

shots.scene: 手推横梁到前面，打开搭扣转旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand pushes the gantry to the front, opens a toggle latch and turns a scaled knob on the cutting head; the machine is idle.
shots.narration: 横梁推到前面，旋钮调到负4。

shots.scene: 旋钮值不对时切不透和挂渣的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an unfinished cut and droplets of dross under a sheet, with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 旋钮不对，会切不透或挂渣。

shots.scene: 关上机盖，按下开始键，观察窗内火花
shots.prompt_en: The lid is closed, a finger presses the glowing start button, and sparks flicker behind the tinted window.
shots.narration: 关盖，按开始键切割。

shots.scene: 戴耐热手套用锤子轻敲零件
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a leather heat-resistant glove taps a cut part out of the sheet with a small hammer; the machine is idle.
shots.narration: 戴耐热手套，用锤子把零件敲下。

shots.scene: 松开夹具，拉出底板取零件
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands loosen the fixtures, lift out the sheet and pull out the base tray to collect small parts.
shots.narration: 松夹具、拉底板，零件都取出。

shots.scene: 拆下切割嘴，装上焊接嘴
shots.prompt_en: Hands remove the cutting tip from the welding head and fit a welding tip, aligning a protrusion with a groove.
shots.narration: 拆切割嘴，装回焊接嘴。

shots.scene: 屏幕参考值与焊接嘴刻度对照
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank value box on the touchscreen and the scale on the welding nozzle with a matching arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 刻度对准参考值，不对就调。

shots.scene: 不锈钢工件和不锈钢焊丝用等号相连
shots.prompt_en: A stainless steel part icon and a wire spool icon joined by an equals sign, and a mismatched spool crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 焊丝材质要和工件一样。

shots.scene: 焊丝从焊接嘴槽里伸出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding wire coming out of the groove on the welding nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 穿好焊丝，从嘴槽里出来。

shots.scene: 两个气瓶图标：氮气、氩气
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinder icons with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接要用氮气或氩气。

shots.scene: 按住扳机泄压，屏幕气压降到零
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses the grip button and trigger; a blank gauge on the touchscreen drops to zero. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 换气前按住扳机泄压，直到0千帕。

shots.scene: 按住卡套拔出旧气管，插上新气管
shots.prompt_en: Close view of fingers pressing a push-fit collet, pulling out one hose and inserting another.
shots.narration: 按住卡套拔旧管，插上氮气管。

shots.scene: 流量计和减压阀两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a transparent flow meter and a pressure regulator with two gauges. No people.
shots.narration: 优先用每分钟15到30升的流量计。

shots.scene: 氮气瓶，减压阀两块表
shots.prompt_en: A nitrogen cylinder with a regulator showing two blank gauges, one for cylinder pressure and one for output. No people.
shots.narration: 没有就用减压阀，一表看瓶内一表看输出。

shots.scene: 按扳机通气时转动减压阀旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the regulator knob while another hand holds the welding head trigger.
shots.narration: 通气调旋钮，屏幕气压约200千帕。

shots.scene: 屏幕选焊接、材料、板厚、丝径
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen with blank buttons for welding mode, material, thickness and wire diameter. No people.
shots.narration: 选焊接、不锈钢、2毫米、1毫米丝。

shots.scene: 启用送丝和出光，点确认
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger taps wire feed and laser enable buttons and a confirm bar. No people besides the finger.
shots.narration: 启用送丝和出光，确认。

shots.scene: 电流回路示意：焊丝—工件—工作台—感应线—焊机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a closed loop with arrows: wire to workpiece, workpiece to metal bench, bench through the sensing cable back to the welder. No people.
shots.narration: 感应线夹在导电工作台上。

shots.scene: 回路断开，焊接头不出光的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of the loop broken at the clamp and a welding head with a blocked beam symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 回路断开，就不会出光。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿防护服，戴防护眼镜、耐热手套和面罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a protective jacket, laser safety goggles, heat-resistant gloves and a face shield.
shots.narration: 焊前穿戴齐全。

shots.scene: 拨开送丝开关，按键调丝，丝尖对红点
shots.prompt_en: A gloved thumb slides the wire switch on, presses the feed button, and the wire tip meets a red aiming dot.
shots.narration: 打开送丝，调到丝尖对准红光。

shots.scene: 焊缝两端先点两个焊点
shots.prompt_en: Two stainless parts held in a jig with two small tack dots at both ends of their joint. No people.
shots.narration: 先焊两端，把位置固定住。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿防护服以45度沿缝焊接，另一只手扶着零件
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a protective jacket and face shield welds along the seam at forty-five degrees while his other hand steadies the stainless parts near the weld.
shots.narration: 焊接头四十五度，一口气焊到底。

shots.scene: 焊接头被轻推的箭头，手稳稳往后带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a small forward push on the welding head and a hand steadily guiding it backward. No people.
shots.narration: 顺着推力，稳稳往后拉。

shots.scene: 架子侧边只在四角点焊
shots.prompt_en: The side frames of the rack are joined only at the corners with small welds. No people.
shots.narration: 受力小的地方，焊几个角就行。

shots.scene: 焊缝边缘发黑的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a weld seam with dark discoloration along the edges. No people.
shots.narration: 焊缝发黑，换清洗嘴来清理。

shots.scene: 拆下焊接嘴和送丝管，装清洗嘴
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands remove the welding nozzle and wire tube and fit a straight cleaning nozzle.
shots.narration: 拆焊接嘴和送丝管，装清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 屏幕选清洗、材料和宽度，阿杰清洗焊缝
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen shows cleaning, material and width buttons; then the young male student in protective gear cleans the seam with the handheld head.
shots.narration: 选清洗参数，启用出光清理。

shots.scene: 调料架装满调料瓶
shots.prompt_en: The finished stainless steel spice rack filled with jars on a counter. No people.
shots.narration: 调料架完成，焊缝又快又漂亮。

shots.scene: 三张空白卡片：备料、切割、焊接
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards in a row with icons of a metal sheet, a cutting machine and a welding head. No people.
shots.narration: 备料、切割、焊接，三步完成。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现板材、推荐表、夹具图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of a metal sheet, a blank table and a fixture clamp.
shots.narration: 按材料选参数，撕膜夹紧。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现引入线、边框、旋钮图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a lead line, a dashed frame and a scaled knob.
shots.narration: 加引入线，走边框，调旋钮，关盖切。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现焊丝、感应线、45度角图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a wire spool, a sensing clamp and a forty-five degree angle.
shots.narration: 配对焊丝，接好回路，四十五度焊。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现清洗嘴、防护眼镜、调料架图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a cleaning nozzle, laser goggles and a spice rack.
shots.narration: 戴好防护焊接，焊完清洗焊缝。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老李围着调料架挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student, the young male student and the facility engineer stand around the finished spice rack and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 调料架做好了，下次见！
